action: A large, cropped cat head drifts slightly in close-up for six frames, then abruptly shrinks to a small full head that slides down and right.
identity_gap: In the close-up frames the head is scaled so large that the ears are cropped off the top, so the doodle's defining ears are absent for most of the shot.
notes: Frames 1-6 are a near-static, slightly wobbling close-up; frame 7 jumps to roughly half scale with no in-between, and frame 8 jumps again in position and tilt. The construction (lumpy polygon head, mismatched polygon eyes, three whiskers a side, tick mark between the ears) matches the doodle closely, though the cartoon's line is thinner than the doodle's.
